message.content: Note a conflict in sources — let me verify against primary sources.
message.reasoning:
There's a conflict: finance-summaries.net says FY2024 revenue $416.2B, net income $112.0B, EPS $7.46 — that looks wrong/fabricated. SEC 10-K says $391,035M revenue, net income $93,736M, EPS $6.08. Let me fetch the Apple newsroom page and the SEC filing to verify.

Note: actual Apple FY2024: revenue $391.04B, net income $93.74B, diluted EPS $6.08. Q4 FY24: revenue $94.93B, net income $14.74B, EPS $0.97. So the finance-summaries.net is a bogus source. Good — I should rely on primary sources.

Let me fetch the Apple newsroom page and SEC filing.
